scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,server "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace web && npm run typecheck --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
